audit.why: Heimerdinger owns every row through first item and Yi only takes 2+ items. Full phases[].side and content win[] agree row-for-row and match the packet chart, and the HARD 8/10 framing matches a 46.88% record in a lane where the losing half is structural rather than execution.
Four spikes placed at 3-5, level 6, first item and late, and breakdown.spikes correctly lists his second turret, full nest, level 6 upgrade and first AP item against Yi's level 6 and on-hit timings.
audit.corrected: Grenade 11s and Micro-Rockets 11s added so 'wait it out' has a number.

audit.whatIsWrong: His E is called the 'CH-3X grenade' throughout — focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], whys[2], spikes[0], early, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1]. Riot's name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade; CH-3X is an outdated name. Separately, nothing states that the grenade stun cancels Meditate — the entry warns only that channelling makes you a stationary target, which understates it: the heal does not just get out-damaged, it gets cut off.
audit.why: The grenade is the single interaction this matchup turns on, so it needs its real name and its real consequence. Its 11s cooldown does not scale with rank, which makes the wait window identical all game and worth stating once.
audit.corrected: Renamed to CH-2 everywhere it appears; Meditate cancellation written into focus.text, loading, dontsFull[1], report[5] and early.

edits.before: His E, the CH-3X stun grenade — it's his only hard lockdown and it catches you the exact moment Alpha Strike's untargetability ends, setting up the turret-plus-jungler kill. Bait it or wait it out before you ever commit.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E, 11s) — his only hard lockdown. It catches you the moment Alpha Strike's untargetability ends and it cancels Meditate outright, so bait it or wait the 11s out before you ever commit.

edits.before: Track his E, the CH-3X stun grenade (the slow-moving missile) — it's his only hard lockdown and the thing that catches you the instant Alpha Strike's untargetability ends; also count his turret placements since the third turret is what fully walls the wave.
edits.after: Track CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E, 11s at every rank) — his only hard lockdown, the thing that catches you the instant Alpha Strike's untargetability ends; also count his turret placements, since the third turret is what fully walls the wave.

edits.before: Channeling W to sustain while standing in the nest just makes you a stationary target the turrets and rockets chew through faster than you heal.
edits.after: Channeling W in the nest makes you a stationary target, and his grenade or an upgraded spell cancels the heal outright the moment it lands on you.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability is your one tool — it blanks his CH-3X (E) stun and dodges turret/rocket damage mid-blink. Wuju Style's true damage ignores any armor he stacks but is wasted poking the nest; Meditate sustains short fights but channels you into a stationary turret target. Highlander dodges the jungle gank his zoning sets up, not the 1v1.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability is your one tool — it blanks his CH-2 grenade (E) and dodges turret and rocket damage mid-blink. Wuju Style's true damage ignores any armour he stacks but is wasted poking the nest; Meditate channels you into a stationary turret target and the grenade stun cancels it outright. Highlander dodges the jungle gank his zoning sets up, not the 1v1.

edits.before: A genuine hard counter (41.86% WR): Heimer zones, pokes, and stuns the exact windows Yi is weakest in. Concede the lane, scale to 2+ items, and win on the map and in open-ground fights — not in front of his nest.
edits.after: A genuine hard counter (46.88% WR over 64 games): Heimer zones, pokes and stuns the exact windows Yi is weakest in. Concede the lane, scale to 2+ items, and win on the map and in open ground — not in front of his nest.

edits.before: At level 3 the CH-3X Grenade (E) stun punishes any Alpha Strike dive.
edits.after: At level 3 the CH-2 Grenade (E) stun punishes any Alpha Strike dive.

edits.before: Heimer walls you out completely: his H-28G Turrets (Q) zone the wave, Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) poke you, and if you Alpha Strike (Q) in he stuns you with a CH-3X Grenade (E) into turret focus. You lose almost every trade under his fort.
edits.after: Heimer walls you out completely: his H-28 G turrets (Q) zone the wave, Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) poke you every 11s, and if you Alpha Strike in he stuns you with the CH-2 Grenade (E, 11s) into turret focus. Every trade under his fort is lost.

edits.before: Heimerdinger hard-counters your early: his H-28G Turrets (Q) zone you off the wave, Micro-Rockets (W) poke you, and any Alpha Strike (Q) engage eats a CH-3X Grenade (E) stun into full turret focus. Don't try to trade — just soak XP and give up some CS.
edits.after: Heimerdinger hard-counters your early: his H-28 G turrets (Q) zone you off the wave, Micro-Rockets (W) poke you, and any Alpha Strike engage eats a CH-2 Grenade (E) stun into full turret focus — it cancels Meditate too. Soak XP and give up some CS.

edits.before: Dive only when his CH-3X Grenade (E) is on cooldown
edits.after: Dive only when his CH-2 Grenade (E, 11s) is on cooldown

edits.before: Land the CH-3X Grenade (E) stun to lock you for turret focus
edits.after: Land the CH-2 Grenade (E) stun to lock you for turret focus

notes: 'CH-3X' is an outdated ability name that had propagated into nine fields across both layers; Riot's current name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. Its 11s cooldown does not change with rank, which is unusual and worth the player knowing. Level chart untouched and consistent across both layers. Sample size here is only 64 games — the win rate is written as the packet reports it, but it is thin.
